title: Section C SC-01: the snipe deadline is fixed once before submit, and the tx is built once, so later escalation attempts reuse a 60-second deadline

evidence.note: V2 deadline = now + 60, computed before the quote, pause checks and the affordability gate
sendTxWithRetry calls txBuilder() once and hands the same tx to every attempt
deliberate private leg: same 60 s pattern

sibling_sites_checked: All deadline sites in the slice: bot.ts:544 (deliberate private, 60 s), :731 (deliberate public, 600 s, single send), :1043 and :1382 (snipes), and the simulation-only deadlines in tokenSafety.ts (:24, :144, :281, :380). Thresholds TH-BUY-04 and TH-BUY-05.
severity_rationale: S3: attempts that start more than 60 s after the deadline was computed are doomed to revert in simulation, which cuts the private escalation short (missed snipes). The strategies simulate before sending, so no gas is lost.
recommendation: Rebuild the tx (fresh deadline) per attempt, or size the deadline to the whole escalation budget; the fix sits in the TX slice's sendTxWithRetry. Card BUY-07.
